  30  
  31  # Annualized ratio of a spread's mean to its volatility. No hurdle, it is a spread.
  32  def ir(series: pd.Series) -> float:

  39  def t_stat(series: pd.Series) -> float:

  45  def sweep(spreads: dict, baseline: pd.Series) -> dict:

  49          rows.append(

  51          )
  52      table = pd.DataFrame(rows)
  53      table.to_csv(OUT / "subset_sweep.csv", index=False)
  54      best = table.loc[table["ir_early"].idxmax()]

  58          ir_full_max=float(table["ir_full"].max()),
  59          early_late_correlation=float(table["ir_early"].corr(table["ir_late"])),

  39  def t_stat(series: pd.Series) -> float:

  51          )
